fact: The Ministry's page says citizens can use the e-Citizen Portal, from computer or mobile, to file administrative procedures, pay taxes and fees, and track their files in real time.

The Ministry's page describes the e-Citizen Portal as a single entry point to all digital public services, with each citizen's unique biometric-authenticated digital identifier as the gateway to all online public services.
The Budget ministry's third steering committee on 6 June 2024 reviewed the E-Bourses project, under execution, to let students apply online for national and cooperation scholarships.
